about.intro: I'm an Information Technology undergraduate at Sasi Institute of Technology & Engineering. I enjoy exploring technology, learning new concepts, and understanding how ideas can become useful applications. I like drawing, designing, and creating, and I prefer learning through practical work and clear, step-by-step understanding.
likes: Drawing and sketching (my favourite way to think visually)
Clean, simple, and organized design — extra points if it's satisfying to look at
Caring for plants (they're very patient teachers)
about.stack: Python (most comfortable), basic Java and C, HTML, CSS, SQL / MySQL, and some Flutter / Dart. Currently exploring UI/UX design as an area of strong interest.
about.current: Currently building my programming foundations — solving LeetCode problems daily with a focus on arrays, learning Data Structures and Algorithms, and working on small projects to understand each part of implementation from scratch.

projects.title: Attendance Management System
projects.blurb: A web app that helps students, faculty, and admins manage attendance without the paper chaos.
projects.long: A team academic web application built with JSP, JDBC, MySQL, XAMPP, and HTML. Supports faculty and student login, student details management, department and course management, attendance marking and viewing, and dashboard pages backed by a MySQL database. This project gave me exposure to connecting web pages with a database and organizing features around different user roles.

projects.title: BMI Calculator
projects.blurb: A simple introductory Flutter app — my first step into mobile development.
projects.long: I tried a simple BMI calculator while beginning to explore Flutter. The initial code was provided as a learning starting point, and I used it to begin understanding how a Flutter application works — how widgets are structured, how inputs connect to outputs, and how state changes. My next goal is to learn Flutter and Dart more deeply and gradually build mobile apps with more independence.

projects.title: FinTech Hackathon
projects.blurb: Explored how technology could reduce faculty workload during paper correction.
projects.long: I participated in a team hackathon focused on the problem of reducing faculty workload during paper correction. The concept explored how technology might make evaluation work more manageable. This experience introduced me to team-based problem exploration and thinking about a practical challenge in an educational setting — something I found genuinely interesting.
